email.subject: Update on your application
email.snippet: Unfortunately we have decided not to move forward.
email.body:
Dear Candidate,

Thank you for your interest in the Frontend Engineer role at Nimbus. After careful consideration, unfortunately we have decided not to move forward with your application at this time. We wish you the best.

Regards,
Nimbus Recruiting
